notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.11 - Script: an Ask step no longer shows PASS while its question is still waiting; its result appears when the operator answers, so a FAIL answer no longer flips an early PASS. Stopping the run while a question waits leaves that step not run. Windows: the file properties of RoachModbusTool.exe now show the app version (they said 0.1.03).
